note: Product-neutral fixtures for registries/operating-model/execution-state.schema.json and scripts/lib/execution-state.mjs. Every `valid` record must pass evaluateExecutionState with no problem; every `invalid` record must produce at least one. One model everywhere: each record declares $schema = ../../registries/operating-model/execution-state.schema.json — a portable relative reference that, resolved INSIDE THE MERIDIAN NAMESPACE, lands exactly on the specialised schema's logical address (the complete schema that composes the reused scoped-record envelope with the body). Resolution and the rooted-path rules are REUSED from scripts/lib/task-specification.mjs — a bare basename, a reference into a namespace segment that is not there, a right-basename/wrong-segment reference and a reference that climbs out of the namespace all resolve elsewhere and are rejected. The managed entity is the execution RUN: one task specification (referenced by a portable task_specification_ref, never embedded) may drive several runs, each with its own id and Russian title. scope is run-state only, with scope.id identifying the run and scope.workspace_id mandatory. The payload carries the independent axes (no single universal status, no leaked role / supervision-mode / communication-mode / context-manifest / evidence / handoff field) and an ordered transition_history whose first record states the initial state, whose ordinal strictly increases, that never breaks the from/to chain, whose last record matches the current axes, and where a backward move, a skipped stage and a transition after a terminal state each carry an explicit basis. No rooted machine path, no file:// and no product literals anywhere.
